reasoning: Both audits confirm PKGBUILD and wrapper script are safe. Unaudited JavaScript files are part of upstream IDE runtime code, not executed during Arch package build/install. No evidence of malicious behavior in packaging.
coverage_issues: Both models failed to audit critical backend JavaScript files (electron-main.js, plugin-host.js, etc.) due to HTTP 413 errors from oversized context
Models prioritized IDE runtime files over build-time scripts despite AUR scope
learnings: Improve file prioritization: Focus exclusively on PKGBUILD hooks, install scripts, and build-time executables for binary packages
Implement size-based filtering: Automatically skip files >50KB unless referenced in PKGBUILD
Enhance error handling: Retry failed audits with chunking for large files
Clarify scope in prompts: Emphasize that runtime application code is out-of-scope unless executed during makepkg
